declarations.name: scorePassword
declarations.description:
The default strength estimate behind the meter: length and character variety (lowercase, uppercase, digits,
symbols), with common passwords and single repeated characters scored 0. It is a hint for the user, not a security
check; hand `scorer` a stronger estimator (zxcvbn, for instance) when the score matters.

A password input: the sign-in and sign-up field of Stripe, GitHub and Carbon. A toggle at the end of the field shows
the password in clear text and hides it again (`revealed`, `reveal-change`; `hide-toggle` removes it). For a new
password, `meter` adds a four-segment strength meter under the field and `requirements` a checklist that ticks
each rule as it is met: the built-in `length` (at least `minlength`, 8 by default), `lowercase`, `uppercase`,
`number` and `symbol`, separated by semicolons, or from script any PasswordRequirement of your own.
While Caps Lock is on and the password is hidden, a warning shows under the field.

The element is form-associated (`name`), so it submits with its form, and validates like an input: `required`,
`minlength`, `maxlength`, and every requirement once something is typed. `input` and `change` are re-dispatched
from the inner input. The strength comes from scorePassword unless `scorer` replaces it; while a requirement
is unmet, it is capped at 1 (weak).

The host exposes its state as custom states: `:state(focus-within)`, `:state(revealed)`, `:state(caps-lock)`,
`:state(error)`, `:state(disabled)`, `:state(requirements-met)` and, while a value is typed, `:state(strength-0)` to
`:state(strength-4)`.
declarations.name: PasswordField

cssProperties.description: Space between the icons and the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-password-field--gap

cssProperties.description: Hit area of the show/hide button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-password-field__toggle--size

cssProperties.description: Space between the field, the meter, the checklist and the helper line.
cssProperties.name: --c2-password-field__supporting-text--gap

cssProperties.description: Text of the Caps Lock warning.
cssProperties.name: --c2-password-field__caps-lock--color

cssProperties.name: --c2-password-field__requirement--gap

slots.description: Icon at the start of the field, e.g. a lock.
slots.name: prefix-icon

slots.description: Replaces the eye shown while the password is hidden.
slots.name: show-icon

slots.description: Replaces the crossed-out eye shown while the password is revealed.

members.name: value
members.description: The password. Setting the attribute after the user has typed no longer updates it, like a native input.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the password is submitted with the form under this name.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the field is empty.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the field. Defaults to the placeholder, then to "Password".

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: Autofill hint: `current-password` for a sign-in form, `new-password` for sign-up and reset forms.

members.name: required
members.description: The field must not be empty.

members.name: minLength
members.description: Minimum length in characters. Also the length the built-in `length` requirement asks for (8 when unset).

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Maximum length in characters.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the field and its toggle.

members.name: revealed
members.description: Shows the password in clear text. The toggle flips it and fires `reveal-change`.

members.name: hideToggle
members.description: Removes the show/hide toggle.

members.name: meter
members.description: Shows the strength meter under the field.

members.name: requirements
members.description:
Checklist shown under the field and checked as the user types: built-in ids (`length`, `lowercase`,
`uppercase`, `number`, `symbol`), separated by semicolons as an attribute, or PasswordRequirement objects
from script.

members.name: strengthLabels
members.description: Labels of the five strength scores, 0 to 4, separated by semicolons.

members.name: scorer
members.description: Replaces scorePassword as the strength estimate. Returns 0 to 4.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the field invalid and shows `error-text` in place of `help`.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown while `error` is set.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text under the field.

members.name: toggleLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the show/hide toggle. Its pressed state says whether the password is shown.

members.name: capsLockText
members.description: Warning shown while Caps Lock is on. Empty turns the warning off.

members.name: requirementsMessage
members.default: 'The password does not meet every requirement.'
members.description: Message of the validity error while a requirement is unmet.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: strength
members.description: The current strength, 0 to 4.

members.name: requirementStates
members.description: Each requirement with whether the current value meets it.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects the whole password.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets a custom validation message; an empty string clears it.

events.name: reveal-change
events.description: The toggle showed or hid the password. Does not bubble.

events.name: strength-change
events.description: The strength score changed while typing. Does not bubble.
Re-dispatched from the inner input on every keystroke; `value` is already updated.
events.name: input

events.description: Re-dispatched from the inner input when the value is committed (blur or Enter).
events.name: change
